facts.current: Exploring a new neighborhood every Sunday
Found a great coffee shop in Daikanyama last weekend
Hasn't explored much of the historical side of Harajuku yet

plans.text: Take a trip to the Japanese Alps in November and stay in Matsumoto, with scenic routes and accommodations in Nagano Prefecture.
Invite friends who live in Tokyo to join the trip for a few days.
Visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center in Matsumoto.
Visit the Japanese Alps Visitor Center, then Matsumoto Castle, and afterward take a stroll along Nawate Street; visit the Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum and Zenko-ji Temple if time permits.
Check out Minato Mirai 21 and the Red Brick Warehouse for their harbor views.
Check out Kawai Shrine when there is a chance.
Check out Kanemasa for kanimeshi and Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nohin-Ichi for namashirasu, and possibly stop by Yokohama Central Market for grilled squid.
Check out the Yokohama Oktoberfest and the Autumn Leaves Festival if they are happening during the trip.

preferences.text: Interested in experiencing traditional Japanese culture and history.
Really enjoying the fall foliage in Tokyo lately.
